title: Why You Still Freeze When Speaking English (Real Talk)

subtitles.en:
Hello, my friends. Welcome, to the AB English
Podcast, Slow English Series.
subtitles.zh: 哈囉，我的朋友們。歡迎收聽 AB 英文廣播的慢速英語系列。

subtitles.en: Today, is a quiet moment, just for you.
subtitles.zh: 今天，是專屬於你的寧靜時光。

subtitles.en:
So, get comfortable. Take a slow, deep
breath, and relax with me.
subtitles.zh: 請找個舒服的姿勢坐好。緩緩地、深深地吸一口氣，和我一起放鬆下來。

subtitles.en:
Today, we are talking about something, you
may have said, to yourself.
subtitles.zh: 今天，我們要聊聊一句，你也許曾對自己說過的話。

subtitles.en: I will speak English, when I feel ready.
subtitles.zh: 「等我準備好了，我就會開口說英文。」

subtitles.en: It sounds, like a safe plan.
subtitles.zh: 這聽起來，是個很安全的計畫。

subtitles.en:
Learn more vocabulary, study more grammar,
and wait, for that perfect day.
subtitles.zh: 背更多的單字，學更多的文法，然後等待那個完美的時刻。

subtitles.en: But, when does that day, really arrive?
subtitles.zh: 但是，那一天，到底什麼時候才會到來呢？

subtitles.en: Let me tell you, about a woman, named Sarah.
subtitles.zh: 讓我告訴你一個女孩的故事，她的名字叫 Sarah。

subtitles.en:
Sarah had a small notebook, with a blue
cover.
subtitles.zh: Sarah 有一本藍色封面精美的小筆記本。

subtitles.en:
Every evening, she wrote five English words,
in it.
subtitles.zh: 每天傍晚，她都會在裡面工工整整寫下五個英文單字。

subtitles.en: Her handwriting, was neat, and beautiful.
subtitles.zh: 她的字跡端正而優美。

subtitles.en:
She highlighted words, with colorful pens,
and added, example sentences.
subtitles.zh: 她用彩色筆標記重點，還會寫下一句句例句。

subtitles.en:
After one year, she had three, full
notebooks.
subtitles.zh: 一年過去了，她累積了滿滿三本筆記。

subtitles.en:
But, she had never spoken a full sentence, to
anyone, in English.
subtitles.zh: 然而，她卻從未用英文，對任何人說過一句完整的話。

subtitles.en:
Then, a new neighbor moved, into the
apartment next door.
subtitles.zh: 後來，隔壁的公寓搬來了一位新鄰居。

subtitles.en: Her name was Kate, and she was from Canada.
subtitles.zh: 她的名字叫 Kate，來自加拿大。

subtitles.en:
One morning, Sarah stepped out, into the
hallway.
subtitles.zh: 某天早晨，Sarah 走出門，來到走廊上。

subtitles.en: She saw Kate, standing, by the entrance door.
subtitles.zh: 她看見 Kate 正站在大門口。

subtitles.en:
Kate was holding two heavy grocery bags,
trying, to find her keys.
subtitles.zh: Kate 提著兩大袋沉甸甸的雜物，正焦急地翻找著鑰匙。

subtitles.en: Sarah felt an urge, to help.
subtitles.zh: Sarah 內心湧起了一股想要上前幫忙的衝動。

subtitles.en: She wanted to say, Can I help you?
subtitles.zh: 她很想開口問：「我可以幫妳嗎？」

subtitles.en: She knew, every single word.
subtitles.zh: 這裡面的每一個字，她明明都清清楚楚地認得。

subtitles.en: Can. I. Help. You.
subtitles.zh: 我。可。以。幫。妳。嗎。

subtitles.en: Just, four simple words.
subtitles.zh: 僅僅只是四個簡簡單單的字。

subtitles.en:
But suddenly, her mind began to race, with
fear.
subtitles.zh: 但在突然間，恐懼在她的腦海中狂奔翻湧。

subtitles.en: What if, she replies too fast?
subtitles.zh: 萬一，她回答得太快怎麼辦？

subtitles.en:
What if, she asks me a question, that I do
not understand?
subtitles.zh: 萬一，她反問了一個我聽不懂的問題該怎麼辦？

subtitles.en: What if, my pronunciation, sounds terrible?
subtitles.zh: 萬一，我的發音聽起來很糟糕該怎麼辦？

subtitles.en:
Sarah froze. She looked down at the floor,
and walked past, silently.
subtitles.zh: Sarah 愣住了。她低下頭盯著地板，默默從身旁快步走過。

subtitles.en:
Back in her room, she sat at her desk, and
felt, a deep sadness.
subtitles.zh: 回到房間後，她坐在書桌前，心中滿是深深的失落。

subtitles.en:
She did not need, more words, in her
notebook.
subtitles.zh: 她的筆記本裡，其實並不需要再多抄任何新單字了。

subtitles.en:
She needed, the courage, to use the words,
she already knew.
subtitles.zh: 她真正需要的，是用出那些早已學會的單字的勇氣。

subtitles.en: The next morning, it happened, again.
subtitles.zh: 隔天早晨，同樣的情景再次上演。

subtitles.en:
Sarah opened her door, and saw Kate, carrying
a large cardboard box.
subtitles.zh: Sarah 打開大門，看見 Kate 正抱著一個巨大的紙箱。

subtitles.en: The fear, returned instantly.
subtitles.zh: 那股恐懼，瞬間再度湧上心頭。

subtitles.en:
Sarah felt her heart, pounding against her
chest, and her palms, were sweating.
subtitles.zh: Sarah 感受到自己的心臟在胸口劇烈跳動，掌心也滿是冷汗。

subtitles.en: She did not, suddenly, feel ready.
subtitles.zh: 她並沒有突然覺得自己準備充分了。

subtitles.en: She was still, terrified.
subtitles.zh: 她的內心，依然充滿了害怕。

subtitles.en:
But this time, she took a breath, and
whispered:
subtitles.zh: 但這一次，她深深吸了一口氣，輕聲說道：

subtitles.en: Can I, help you?
subtitles.zh: 「需要我幫忙嗎？」

subtitles.en: Kate looked up, and gave her, a warm smile.
subtitles.zh: Kate 抬起頭來，向她展露了一個無比溫暖的微笑。

subtitles.en: Yes, please! Could you, hold the door?
subtitles.zh: 「好呀，麻煩妳了！可以幫我扶著門嗎？」

subtitles.en: Sarah heard, the word, door.
subtitles.zh: Sarah 清楚聽見了「門」這個字。

subtitles.en:
She saw the box, and she understood,
completely.
subtitles.zh: 她看了一眼大紙箱，瞬間完全明白了。

subtitles.en:
She stepped forward, and held the door, open
wide.
subtitles.zh: 她走上前去，替對方將大門穩穩地敞開。

subtitles.en:
Kate walked through, and said,  Thank you so
much!
subtitles.zh: Kate 邁步走了進去，笑著說道：「真的太謝謝妳了！」

subtitles.en:
And Sarah answered, with a smile,  You are
welcome!
subtitles.zh: 而 Sarah 也帶著微笑輕聲回應：「不客氣！」

subtitles.en: That, was all.
subtitles.zh: 就只是這樣而已。

subtitles.en:
No long speech. No advanced grammar. No
Shakespeare.
subtitles.zh: 沒有長篇大論，沒有深奧的文法，也沒有莎士比亞名句。

subtitles.en: Just a door, a box, and a kind gesture.
subtitles.zh: 就只是一扇門、一個紙箱，以及一份溫柔的心意。

subtitles.en: But inside Sarah, the world, shifted.
subtitles.zh: 但在 Sarah 的內心深處，世界卻悄然改變了。

subtitles.en:
Before that morning, speaking English, was
only a distant dream.
subtitles.zh: 在那天早晨之前，開口說英文對她而言，只是一個遙不可及的夢想。

subtitles.en:
Now, it was something real, that she had
actually done.
subtitles.zh: 但現在，它已化為現實，成了她親身實踐過的事情。

subtitles.en: That night, Sarah opened, her notebook.
subtitles.zh: 那天夜裡，Sarah 輕輕翻開了自己的筆記本。

subtitles.en:
Underneath her list of words, she wrote, one
single sentence, in ink.
subtitles.zh: 在她密密麻麻的單字清單下方，她用墨水工整地寫下了一句話：

subtitles.en: Today, I used, my English.
subtitles.zh: 「今天，我開口用了英文。」

subtitles.en: Today, I used, my English.
subtitles.zh: 「今天，我開口用了英文。」

subtitles.en:
What a powerful sentence. Perhaps, you need
to say that, to yourself, too.
subtitles.zh: 多麼有力量的一句話啊。也許，你也需要對自己這麼說。

subtitles.en:
You do not need, to deliver, a flawless
speech.
subtitles.zh: 你不需要發表一場無懈可擊的演說。

subtitles.en:
You do not need, to talk for ten minutes,
without stopping.
subtitles.zh: 你也不需要一刻不停頓地連續講上十分鐘。

subtitles.en: Your first step, can be very, very small.
subtitles.zh: 你的第一步，其實可以非常、非常微小。

subtitles.en: Say, good morning, to a barista.
subtitles.zh: 向咖啡師微笑道一聲早安。

subtitles.en: Tell someone, you like their shoes.
subtitles.zh: 誇讚身邊的人鞋子很好看。

subtitles.en: Ask, where the bus station is.
subtitles.zh: 輕聲詢問公車站牌在哪裡。

subtitles.en:
You do not need, to tell your whole life
story.  You only need, to begin.
subtitles.zh: 你不需要傾訴整個人生故事，你只需要跨出第一步。

subtitles.en:
Think about, making a cup of tea, in a
friend's kitchen.
subtitles.zh: 想像一下，在朋友家的廚房裡泡一杯茶的場景。

subtitles.en:
You do not know, where the tea bags are. And
you cannot, find a spoon.
subtitles.zh: 你不知道茶包放在哪裡，也找不到攪拌匙。

subtitles.en:
Do you stand in the corner, silently,
waiting, until you know everything?
subtitles.zh: 難道你會默默站在角落發呆，一直等到摸透所有事物才行動嗎？

subtitles.en: Of course, not!
subtitles.zh: 當然不會！

subtitles.en: You simply ask,  Where are the cups?
subtitles.zh: 你只會自然地開口問：「茶杯放在哪裡呀？」

subtitles.en:
Your friend points to a cupboard, and you
continue.
subtitles.zh: 朋友隨手指向櫥櫃，你就能順利接著把茶泡好了。

subtitles.en: Learning English, is just like that.
subtitles.zh: 學習英文，其實也是一模一樣的道理。

subtitles.en:
You find your way, while you are inside, the
conversation.
subtitles.zh: 你是在融入對話的流動中，慢慢找到方向的。

subtitles.en:
What if, someone speaks, and you do not
understand?
subtitles.zh: 萬一別人開口說話，而你聽不懂該怎麼辦呢？

subtitles.en:
Do not panic. Just keep these four simple
phrases, in your pocket.
subtitles.zh: 別慌張。只要將這四句簡單的救急錦囊，悄悄收進口袋裡就好。

subtitles.en:
Number one,  Could you say that again,
please?
subtitles.zh: 第一句：「可以請您再說一次嗎？」

subtitles.en: Number two,  A little slower, please.
subtitles.zh: 第二句：「可以請您說慢一點點嗎？」

subtitles.en: Number three,  I am still, learning English.
subtitles.zh: 第三句：「我還在學習英文。」

subtitles.en: And number four,  What does that word, mean?
subtitles.zh: 第四句：「那個字是什麼意思呢？」

subtitles.en:
When people hear these sentences, they are
almost always, happy to help.
subtitles.zh: 當人們聽見這些話語時，幾乎總是會滿心歡喜地，為你伸出援手。

subtitles.en:
Some days, speaking English, will feel light,
and easy.
subtitles.zh: 在某些日子裡，開口說英文會感覺格外輕鬆、自在。

subtitles.en:
Other days, you will feel clumsy, and forget
words.
subtitles.zh: 而在另一些日子裡，你或許會感到笨拙，甚至忘記該說的單字。

subtitles.en: Let that, be okay.
subtitles.zh: 請溫柔地接納這一切，這真的沒有關係。

subtitles.en: Every stumble, is proof, that you are trying.
subtitles.zh: 每一次的結巴與踉蹌，都是你正勇敢嘗試的最好證明。

subtitles.en:
Remember, you do not need, to be ready, to
speak.
subtitles.zh: 請牢記，你不需要等到一切都準備完美，才敢開口。

subtitles.en: You speak, and then, you become ready.
subtitles.zh: 正是因為你勇敢開口了，你才會一步步做好準備。

subtitles.en:
Thank you, for spending this peaceful time
with me, on the AB English Podcast, Slow
English Series.
subtitles.zh: 謝謝你在 AB 英語播客的慢速英語系列中，與我共享這段寧靜的時光。

subtitles.en:
If this story touched your heart, please give
it a thumbs up, and subscribe to our channel.
subtitles.zh: 如果這個故事悄悄觸動了你的心，請給我們一個喜歡，並訂閱我們的頻道。

subtitles.en:
Share this, with someone who is learning
English, and needs a little encouragement,
today.
subtitles.zh: 也請把這份溫暖，分享給身邊正在學習英文、今天正好需要一點點鼓勵的朋友。

subtitles.en:
Until next time, be kind to yourself, keep
listening, and keep speaking.
subtitles.zh: 在下次相遇之前，請溫柔地對待自己，持續聆聽，也請繼續勇敢地開口。

subtitles.en: Good night, and see you soon.
subtitles.zh: 祝你晚安，我們很快就會再相見。
